# SOP-02: Settling the exceptions list

## Purpose

This procedure is how item 2 of the new process is done. [map/future.md item 2]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| order coordinator | settles each line every morning |
| operations manager | decides on a line the order coordinator cannot settle |

## When

Every working morning, before new orders arrive. [SC-10]

## Steps

1. Open the exceptions list (software step: see the Order coordinator guide, "Settle the morning's exceptions list"). [SC-10 step 1]
2. Settle each line: correct the code or note it for the customer; never guess a code. [map/future.md item 2]

## Exceptions and who handles them

A line no one can settle stays on the list and goes to the operations manager. [map/future.md item 2]

## Escalation

The operations manager. [map/roles.md operations manager]

## Records kept

The exceptions list keeps every settled line. The client has not said how long these are kept; ask before setting a period.

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2027-02-03]
